title: Garmin Power Meter Sprint Fade by Interval
dataSources: Whoop recovery and strain (`whoop:day`), Garmin ride power (`powermeter:ride`), Stryd runs (`stryd:run`), and gymnastics skill attempts (`gymnastics:skill`).
app: Training telemetry from Whoop, Garmin power meters, Stryd running power, and gymnastics skill trackers maintained in Sheets or app exports sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:ride
| search power_fade_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(power_fade_pct) as avg_power_fade_pct max(power_fade_pct) as max_power_fade_pct by _time workout_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks sprint fade across intervals over time and breaks it out by workout.
value: Sprint fade makes it easier to see whether repeatability is improving instead of only looking at your best number.
implementation: Send sprint fade across intervals events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of sprint fade across intervals by workout.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how sprint fade across intervals changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
